title: Expiry Terms and Reinstatement Charges by Wanderlane Traveller Club Tier
content:
Two clocks are shown against a Wanderlane Traveller Club membership statement, and they measure different things. The expiry term is the number of calendar months after which unused spendable points lapse. The inactivity term is the number of calendar months of complete inactivity after which the membership itself lapses. A third figure on the same statement, the reinstatement window, is the number of calendar days after lapse within which points may still be reinstated, and the reinstatement fee is the fee charged to reinstate points that have already lapsed, in US dollars.

## Terms by tier

| Tier | Expiry term, calendar months | Expiry clock reset by qualifying activity | Inactivity term, calendar months | Reinstatement window, calendar days | Reinstatement fee, USD |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Wanderlane Blue | 18 | no | 24 | 0 | 150.00 |
| Wanderlane Silver | 24 | yes | 24 | 30 | 125.00 |
| Wanderlane Gold | 24 | yes | 30 | 60 | 95.00 |
| Wanderlane Platinum | 36 | yes | 36 | 90 | 75.00 |
| Wanderlane Titanium | 36 | yes | 36 | 180 | 0.00 |
| Wanderlane Ambassador | 48 | yes | 48 | 365 | 0.00 |

The reset column records whether any qualifying activity resets the expiry clock on the whole balance. It is recorded as no at Wanderlane Blue alone and as yes at each of the five tiers above it.

## Reading the two terms apart

The expiry term and the inactivity term carry the same figure at Wanderlane Silver, at Wanderlane Platinum, at Wanderlane Titanium and at Wanderlane Ambassador. They differ at Wanderlane Blue, where the expiry term is 18 calendar months against an inactivity term of 24, and at Wanderlane Gold, where the expiry term is 24 calendar months against an inactivity term of 30. They remain two separate figures wherever they agree: the first is measured against points, the second against the membership.

## The two reinstatement figures together

The window and the fee are read as a pair. At Wanderlane Blue the window is 0 calendar days and the fee is 150.00; at Wanderlane Silver the window is 30 calendar days and the fee is 125.00; at Wanderlane Gold, 60 days and 95.00; at Wanderlane Platinum, 90 days and 75.00; at Wanderlane Titanium, 180 days and no fee; and at Wanderlane Ambassador, 365 days and no fee.
